test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option of the given sentence.

Smt. Savithri is wisest than all others in the group.

options.text: Smt. Savithri is the wiser than all others in the group.
Smt. Savithri is wise than all others in the group.
Smt. Savithri is wiser than all others in the group.
Smt. Savithri is the wise than all others in the group.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e.Smt. Savithri is wiser than all others in the group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is comparing Smt. Savithri to all others in the group, which requires the use of a comparative adjective.
 
• Comparative adjectives are used to compare differences between two objects (or people).
 
• The correct form of the comparative adjective for "wise" is "wiser".

Correct sentence: *Smt. Savithri is wiser than all others in the group.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Adjectives:**

 
 
• **Structure:** adjective + -er (for one-syllable adjectives) or more + adjective (for adjectives with two or more syllables).
 
• **Example:** She is taller than her brother.
 
• **Usage: **Used to compare differences between two people or things.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Adjectives:**
 
 
• **Structure: **adjective + -est (for one-syllable adjectives) or most + adjective (for adjectives with two or more syllables).
 
• **Example: **She is the tallest in her class.
 
• **Usage: **Used to describe the highest degree of a quality among three or more people or things.
